name: @ifos/workos
description: IFOS WorkOS MCP connector — long-lived secret-key bearer auth + organizations/connections/directory-sync read endpoints + per-org_id rate-limit + typed errors. Used by tenant onboarding + admin SSO surfaces. WorkOS AuthKit per docs/build-brief/00-MASTER-BRIEF.md §5.3 line 401 is the v1.0 auth substrate; this package wraps the org/connection/directory-sync read surface that v1.0 admin flows need. SCIM provisioning + audit-log are deferred to v1.1+.
